Nashville THC FAQs

Green Treez Nashville Dispensary

What types of products are available at Green Treez?

We offer a wide range of products, including smokable flower (High THCa or CBD Dominant), edibles, concentrates, tinctures, topicals, and more. We also offer accessories (in-store only)
What are your operating hours, and are you open on holidays?

Our dispensary is open from 10 AM to 7 PM Monday through Saturday. We have reduced hours on major holidays, which we post in advance on our website and store front.
What do I need to bring with me?

Please bring a valid original form of government-issued ID to prove you are over the age of 21. Unfortunately, we’re unable to use copies or screenshots of IDs.
What forms of payment do you accept?

We accept cash, debit cards, and credit cards. Please note that there may be an additional transaction fee for card payments.
Do you offer Nashville cannabis delivery?

Yes! We offer delivery to a number of zip codes and communities in the Nashville area. Visit our local delivery page to learn more.
Are there any discounts or loyalty programs available?

Yes, we offer a loyalty program where you can earn points with every purchase. Be sure to ask our staff about how to sign up and save! We also offer a Veterans/Military discount.
Can you help me understand the different types of cannabis you offer?

Absolutely! We offer a variety of strains, each with unique effects and benefits. Our knowledgeable budtenders can explain the differences between indica, sativa, and hybrid strains, and help you choose the best option for your needs. Be sure to. heck out our Articles and Education.
How can I tell which cannabis product is right for me?

Our staff is here to help! We’ll discuss your preferences and purposes for using cannabis, whether it’s for relaxation, medical relief, or other uses, and recommend products that match your needs.
Do you offer any CBD products that don't produce a high?

Yes, we have a wide range of CBD products that do not have psychoactive effects, including tinctures, lotions, and edibles. These products provide various therapeutic benefits without the high associated with THC.
Is it legal to buy cannabis in Nashville?

Yes, it is legal to purchase cannabis in Nashville if you are 21 years of age or older.
Can I consume weed products within Nashville city limits?

Cannabis consumption is allowed in private residences, but public consumption is illegal. Please consume responsibly and within the confines of private property.
